steps.title: Initial lineup
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Go to 4m north-west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 4m south-west of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 8m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 8m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 4m north-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 4m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 8m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 8m east of the centre.
